name: Portolan
feature_notes: The new Streetwise workspace in Workspaces & Programs lets a contractor test the regional address lookup and download the standalone kit. The kit includes a working example that runs on the contractor’s own site.

backend_prerequisite.reason: Existing Countercraft backend is active; this build requires idle-v1 service and SQL upgrade before customer kiosk use. No Ike publication configured at read-only audit. Old service is rejected by kiosk.
